const SERIAL = 1;
const MODULE_WIDTH = Math.min(1, CPU_COUNT);

// CASE let_min_one expect=fire
export async function letMinOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	let width = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE var_min_one expect=fire
export async function varMinOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	var width = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE typed_const_min_one expect=fire
export async function typedConstMinOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width: number = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE const_min_three expect=fire
export async function constMinThree(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(n, items.length, 1);
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE module_min_one expect=fire
export async function moduleMinOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit(items, MODULE_WIDTH, op);
}

// CASE local_const_one expect=fire
export async function localConstOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const width = 1;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE local_let_one_unchanged expect=fire
export async function localLetOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	let width = 1;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE typed_const_one expect=fire
export async function typedConstOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const width: number = 1;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE module_const_one expect=fire
export async function moduleConstOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit(items, SERIAL, op);
}

// CASE min_cap_nested_closure expect=fire
export async function minCapNested(groups: string[][], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(1, n);
	await Promise.all(groups.map((group) => mapLimit(group, width, op)));
}

// CASE let_min_one_reassigned expect=pass
export async function letMinReassigned(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number, fast: boolean) {
	let width = Math.min(1, n);
	if (fast) width = 8;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE const_min_four expect=pass
export async function constMinFour(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(4, n);
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE generic_local_min_one expect=fire
export async function genericLocalMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, width, op);
}

// CASE generic_local_const_one expect=fire
export async function genericLocalOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const width = 1;
	await mapLimit<string>(items, width, op);
}

// CASE generic_module_const_one expect=fire
export async function genericModuleOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, SERIAL, op);
}

// CASE generic_let_min_one expect=fire
export async function genericLetMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	let width = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, width, op);
}

declare const CPU_COUNT: number;
declare function mapLimit<T>(...args: unknown[]): Promise<void>;
